findings.description: The source rejects private literal IPv4 destinations for this caller URL before the request. Complete scheme and destination restrictions remain unestablished; this candidate does not allege an initial literal IPv4 loopback bypass. DNS, redirects and broader IPv6 protection are not established by that address check.
findings.remediation: Permit only required HTTP(S) destinations, reject private and loopback addresses, and enforce checks on every requested URL and redirect.
findings.title: Server-side request forgery
